title: The tilde
comment: One character, and every run is a different picture. A circle whose size is a
number, run three times: the same circle. The size drawn with `~between`: three
runs, three circles, one program — and three more. The same seed twice: the
same picture, byte for byte. The sizes you see are this very program's own
draws (r1 to r7 below), so the pictures are honest.

sections.name: the hook: the mark in red, the episode
sections.label: chance
sections.say: One character. Every run, a different picture.
stage: let hk1 = text("01  ·  the tilde", x: 0.5, y: 0.74, size: 0.036, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hk2 = text("alea, one feature at a time", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hookf = max(wave * RED, max(hk1 * INK, hk2 * GREY))

sections.name: one number: a circle, its size 0.3
sections.label: one number
sections.say: A circle. Its size is a number.
stage: let onef = max(k2_code, max(f2 * RULE, d2 * INK))

sections.name: three runs: the same circle, three times
sections.label: three runs
sections.say: Run it three times. The same circle, three times.
stage: let threef = max(k2_code, max(f3 * RULE, max(d3 * INK, g3 * GREY)))

sections.name: the tilde: the size drawn between 0.1 and 0.5
sections.label: the tilde
sections.say: Now the tilde: draw the size, between point one and five.
stage: let tildef = max(k4_code, max(f4 * RULE, max(d4 * INK, g4 * GREY)))

sections.name: three more runs: three pictures, one program
sections.label: three runs
sections.say: Three runs. Three pictures. One program.
stage: let runsf = max(k4_code, max(f5 * RULE, max(d5 * INK, g5 * GREY)))

sections.name: the seed: the same seed, the same picture
sections.label: the seed
sections.say: Keep the seed, and you keep the picture. Byte for byte.
stage: let g6 = merge(text("seed 7", x: 0.3, y: 0.95, size: 0.024, font: "mono") * (T >= 36.6), text("seed 7", x: 0.7, y: 0.95, size: 0.024, font: "mono") * (T >= 38.4))
let bb6 = text("byte for byte", x: 0.5, y: 1.1, size: 0.05, font: "mono") * (T >= l6.words[8])
let seedf = max(k6_code, max(f6 * RULE, max(d6 * INK, max(g6 * GREY, max(eq6 * INK, bb6 * RED)))))

sections.name: the end: the whole program, the name, where to try it, what comes next
sections.say: Next week: fields. A picture is a function of x and y.
stage: let nsize = 0.2
let nadv = 0.5172 * nsize
let nx0e = 0.5 - 2.5 * nadv
let name2 = text("alea", x: nx0e, y: 0.56, size: nsize, font: "mono", align: "left") * (T >= 44.8)
let ecur = (abs(x - (nx0e + 4.5 * nadv)) < nadv * 0.42) * (abs(y - 0.56) < nsize * 0.4) * blink * (T >= 44.8)
let e1 = text("one feature at a time  ·  01  ·  the tilde", x: 0.5, y: 0.70, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 45.3)
let e2 = text("alea.bngz.io", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.06, font: "mono") * (T >= 45.8)
let e3 = text("next  ·  02  ·  fields", x: 0.5, y: 0.94, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= l7.words[2])
let e4 = text("open source  ·  github.com/sudo-bngz/alea", x: 0.5, y: 1.02, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 47.0)
let endf = max(k7_code, max(name2 * INK, max(ecur * RED, max(e1 * INK, max(e2 * RED, max(e3 * GREY, e4 * INK))))))
